annotations.title: Short extractive English summary of the latest news on a keyword

description:
Short extractive English summary of the latest news on a keyword. 3-5 sentence extractive summary of the latest news matching q (limit 1-50, default 10): lead sentence + de-duplicated headlines, high-importance first

GET /news/summary — price $0.008 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

limit.description: Number of latest matching items to summarize (default 10, max 50) Default: 10.

q.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

name: summarize_news
title: Short extractive English summary of the latest news on a keyword
